titleStmt.title: Manuscript P77, from the Center for New Testament Restoration

publicationStmt.p: The holder publishes this transcription as plain text, not XML. This file places that text, unchanged, in a TEI P5 document, which is the closest scholarly standard for a transcription of a single manuscript.
